status: post-opening cross-axis diagnostic frozen before readback
ecological_question: Does a species' early-period activation geometry predict the magnitude of its later wet-versus-dry acoustic response?

predictor.meaning: opportunity-corrected tendency for wetter-run gain incidences to enter newly active versus already-active stops

outcome.meaning: adjusted wet-only versus dry-only species response magnitude

species_family.rule: intersection of species present in both frozen summaries

interpretation.strong_association: |rho| >= 0.6 and P < 0.05 suggests response magnitude and activation geometry are strongly coupled
interpretation.otherwise: do not claim statistical independence; describe magnitude and geometry as conceptually distinct response coordinates with no strong detected cross-axis coupling

secondary.weighted_regression: WLS late_adjusted_log_odds ~ early_geometry weighted by inverse late-response variance with HC3 covariance
secondary.sign_groups: compare weighted mean late response magnitude for early spatial-edge activators (>0) versus local deepeners (<0), descriptive only

boundaries: This diagnostic does not test statistical independence or equivalence.
Predictor and outcome are estimated in non-overlapping periods but from the same species set.
No alternative time split, magnitude estimator or geometry definition may replace the frozen specification after readback.
